title: Генерация текстов и редактура
story: A single upright page on the left of a plane, from which a thin crimson hairline column of text-lines flows right through two thin panes of frosted glass: the first pane scatters the lines and the second gathers them into short, even rows. A faint grid of pale hairlines fades across the plane beneath.

title: Изображения в стиле бренда
story: A row of frames settling onto one palette of four swatches, a crimson hairline locking the grid, each frame edge aligned to a shared reference point. No cameras, no faces.

title: Видеогенерация или студия
story: Two currents of light cross a dark hall: one assembles from drifting particles, one cast from a warm lamp, meeting in a single crimson thread at center

title: Презентации и документы
story: A series of translucent rectangular planes floating in layered perspective, one edged in crimson, connected by fine lines along a rising diagonal across a calm neutral void.

title: Обучение видеопродакшену с ИИ
story: A ribbon of pale rectangular panels unspools across a dark floor toward a single crimson-lit block, dim shadow band beneath, thin geometric lines connecting each panel.

title: Обучение презентациям и документам
story: A quiet arrangement of translucent panels and geometric planes assembling into a deliberate vertical structure, thin crimson seams tracing the joins, the lower third dissolving into calm empty mist.

title: Разработка систем обработки естественного языка
story: A dense field of pale converging ribbons threads through a dark lattice, one crimson filament splitting from the weave and drifting upward into still air.

title: Разработка систем рекомендаций
story: Dense field of small neutral pebbles flows down a gentle slope, reordering into braided channels; one crimson stream threads the upper cluster, the lower band smooth and dark.

title: Разработка систем распознавания речи
story: Thin crimson sound ripples descend through a wireframe prism, fanning into three parallel tracks of light that converge and settle into a calm, empty lower band.

title: Разработка систем обучения с подкреплением
story: Stepping-stone path arcs across dark still water; a faint glow brightens stone by stone toward one distant crimson-lit slab; calm uncluttered horizon beneath.
